lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Hello there! I'm Tilly, and I collect <color=red>stories</color>.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Listen carefully to my story, then answer four questions. If you get them all right, four new <color=red>books</color> will appear in the library!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Marta was the keeper of a <color=red>lighthouse</color> on a windswept cliff. Every evening she climbed two hundred steps to light the great lantern.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: One stormy night, the lantern flickered and went out. Far below, a fishing boat was <color=red>searching</color> for the harbour in the dark.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Marta had no matches left, so she <color=red>hurried</color> down to the village to borrow some. The baker lent her a box, and she raced back up the stairs.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: At last the lantern blazed. The boat followed its light and landed safely, and the fishermen cheered.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 1: How many steps did Marta climb each evening?
lines.hint: Not quite. Look back at the first part of the story!
lines.correctText: Correct! Two hundred steps every evening.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 2: Why was the fishing boat in danger?
lines.hint: Not quite. What happened on the stormy night?
lines.correctText: Yes! Without the light, the boat could not find the harbour.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 3: Who lent Marta some matches?
lines.hint: Not quite. Think about who she met in the village.
lines.correctText: Right! The baker lent her a box.

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: Question 4: In the story, what does <color=red>hurried</color> mean?
lines.hint: Not quite. Marta was in a rush, remember!

lines.speaker: Tilly
lines.text: All four correct! You listen very well. Four new <color=red>books</color> are on their way to the library!

afterLines.speaker: Tilly
afterLines.text: Thank you for being such a good listener. Have a look at the library, it's filling up nicely!
